title: Normalize Shooting Plugin Crate To Consistency Contract
description: Normalize shooting/plugin/rs/lib.rs (and any colocated fixtures/manifests under shooting/**) to the repo-wide Consistency Contract: adopt framework PanelKit (tree_item_with_action/PanelTreeBuilder) for build_document_tree/build_catalogue_tree, adopt Terminology (app_labels!/LocaleLabels/resolve_labels/localized_label_map/AppLabelsOverlayExt) replacing the hand-rolled ShootingLabels struct+consts+resolver and hand-rolled action/utility label-map functions, verify C1 app-struct naming (ShootingPlayApp already matches PascalCase(shooting-play)+App), fix C2/C3 region naming/order (rename registration region to Manifest if needed, tests region to 🧪Tests, canonical region order Constants->Types->DocumentHelpers->Terminology->CommandLabels->Panels->Render->App impl->Manifest->Tests), confirm C4 (single-app crate stays flat, no wrapping mod), verify resource_kind(...) already present on the AppBuilder chain, and adopt framework Testkit (testkit::meta/new_app/new_app_with_registry/assert_undo_redo_round_trip/assert_two_instances_converge/assert_ingest_idempotent) for the 3 generic test shapes while leaving app-unique tests untouched.
summary: Normalized shooting/plugin/rs/lib.rs to the Consistency Contract. C1: app struct ShootingPlayApp already matched PascalCase(shooting-play)+App — no rename needed. C2/C3: renamed the registration region to 🔖Manifest (was already correctly named) and reordered/renamed regions into canonical order Constants->Types->DocumentHelpers->Terminology->CommandLabels->Panels->Render->Utilities->ShootingPlayApp->Manifest->🧪Tests (Runtime->Types, ActionHelpers->DocumentHelpers with default_fixture/next_shooting_id folded in, CommandLabels moved from after Utilities to right after Terminology, duplicate old CommandLabels region deleted). C4: single-app crate confirmed flat (one `impl DocumentApp for ShootingPlayApp`), no wrapping mod needed. Verified `.resource_kind(ResourceKindSpec{...})` already present on the AppBuilder chain (Wave-1 work, untouched). C6: Cargo.toml confirmed no app-to-app plugin dependency. PanelKit: deleted the local hand-rolled `tree_item_with_action` (icon_id-based) and rewrote build_document_tree/build_catalogue_tree on `semio_framework_plugin::PanelTreeBuilder`; added a small local `tree_item_with_icon` wrapper layering `icon_id` onto the SDK's `tree_item_with_action` skeleton (the SDK primitive's 3rd param is `description`, not an icon — no icon-carrying primitive exists, so this stays app-local via struct-update syntax). Terminology: replaced the hand-rolled `ShootingLabels` struct + EN/DE consts + resolver fn with `semio_framework_plugin::app_labels!`/`LocaleLabels`/`resolve_labels::<ShootingLabels>`; replaced the two hand-rolled (id,en,de)->label-map functions with `localized_label_map`; replaced the manual `AppLabelsOverlay{...}` struct literal in `app_labels()` with the `AppLabelsOverlayExt` fluent builder (`.window_kind_label(...).action_labels(...).utility_labels(...)` off `AppLabelsOverlay::default()`). Testkit: replaced local `meta()`/`new_app()`/`new_app_with_registry()`/manual `MemoryBackbone::pair` scaffolding with `semio_framework_plugin::testkit::*`; migrated the 3 generic-shape tests (`undo_redo_round_trip_through_the_wrapper` -> `testkit::assert_undo_redo_round_trip`, `two_instances_converge_disjoint_edits_via_backbone` -> `testkit::assert_two_instances_converge` with a `(String,[f64;3])` tuple probe covering both sides' disjoint edits, `ingest_operations_is_idempotent_for_shooting` -> `testkit::assert_ingest_idempotent`); all other app-unique tests (coalesced-drag, gumball-drag, world-pick/hover, label locale resolution, DWG import, registry-defaults, utility-registry, etc.) left untouched apart from the `&meta(` -> `&testkit::meta(` call-site rename (41 occurrences). File shrank 2251 -> 2049 lines. No app-fixture/manifest files exist outside shooting/plugin/rs/lib.rs that needed touching (shooting/example/base-icon.shooting.json and shooting/rs/lib.rs are unaffected domain/fixture files, left as-is). Verified: rustfmt --config-path rustfmt.toml --check parses the whole file cleanly with zero syntax errors (only pre-existing manual-formatting-vs-rustfmt-style diffs, present before my edit too, not introduced by it); brace/paren balance is exact (442/442, 2049/2049); exhaustive grep across shooting/** confirms zero residue of every removed/renamed identifier (SHOOTING_LABELS_NATIVE_EN/DE, the old icon_id-based tree_item_with_action, shooting_labels(), ActionMeta, MemoryBackbone::pair, BackboneMessage, the old 🔖Runtime/🔖ActionHelpers/duplicate 🔖CommandLabels region markers) except one accurate prose mention of "MemoryBackbone" left in a doc comment describing what testkit does under the hood; manually cross-referenced every SDK primitive's real signature against framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs's PanelKit/Terminology/Testkit regions before using it. SKIPPED: a full `cargo check -p shooting-plugin --lib --tests` was started but sat with zero output for several minutes (file-lock contention from concurrent sessions, as flagged by the environment) — per the verification policy this was not blocked on further; the orchestrator's final full workspace check will confirm compilation. No SDK-primitive gaps to flag for Wave 4: the only friction was PanelKit's `tree_item_with_action` not carrying an icon_id (3rd param is `description`), worked around locally via struct-update syntax on top of the SDK skeleton, consistent with the precedent already used in sequence/plugin.
